title: Rona Senyap di Perjalanan Sore
theme: Mengeksplorasi bagaimana pertemuan singkat dan misterius dalam perjalanan sehari-hari dapat memicu ketertarikan mendalam serta rasa ingin tahu tentang kisah hidup orang asing.

cover.prompt: Golden hour in Jakarta, soft, warm light bathing a public transport station platform. Blurred forms of commuters create a sense of routine and subtle observation. The city architecture is visible in the distance under a reddish-orange sky. Focus on the gentle interplay of light and the overall environment, with a shallow depth of field. Emphasize the quiet atmosphere of the late afternoon, with no specific human features, only the overall flow of movement.
cover.style: Cinematic photography, shallow depth of field, warm color grading

meta.plan_summary: Anya, a young graphic designer, becomes fascinated by a mysterious 'Silent Man' she observes daily on her commute, noting his peculiar habits and objects. Their silent interactions are limited to fleeting glances until a sudden bus brake causes him to drop a unique compass keychain. As Anya returns it, their hands and eyes meet in a brief, charged moment. He smiles faintly and exits at an unexpected stop, leaving Anya with a persistent sense of wonder and acceptance of the beautiful, unresolved mystery.
meta.target_emotion: Curiosity, subtle longing, quiet wonder, appreciation for unsolved mysteries, gentle romantic intrigue.
